concept: Choosing a colour for the reader's own content as round named swatches, the chosen one ringed and checked, with a hex field for any other.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a color picker with a large saturation square and a rainbow hue strip
default_to_avoid.kind: color picker, colour picker, swatch picker
default_to_avoid.why_not: a saturation square is a tool for artists and hides names; Pane offers named swatches and a hex field

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: the swatch colours belong to the content being coloured and the picker itself stays without hue

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the chosen swatch is ringed in the loud solid and carries a check, so the choice reads by shape

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: each swatch sits in a 44px press area even though the colour itself is smaller

variants.reason: A names every colour (P6) and keeps the picker without hue (P1). B hides names behind a square. C looks different on every platform.

root.why: the swatches, the hex field and the name stack with a small gap

swatches.why: the swatches wrap in rows with the same gap between them

item.why: each swatch is a 44px round radio filled with its colour and ringed so a pale colour still has an edge

check.why: the chosen swatch carries a check in a small loud disc at its centre

preview.why: the hex field starts with a disc of the typed colour with the same rim

hex.why: the hex value is uppercase in tabular figures so it reads as a code

name.why: the name of the chosen colour is shown and announced so it is never chosen by sight alone

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the swatches keep their own colour and gain a system edge

data-state=checked.why: the chosen swatch is ringed in the loud solid

active.why: a pressed swatch shrinks slightly as something pushed

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows on the swatch reached by the arrow keys

data-disabled.why: an off control dims and refuses presses, so it reads as there but not available

transform.why: the press shrink uses the short press ease because a press is a reply
